title: Study and Teaching
scope: Free-floating --Study and teaching subdivisions, including the eleven level-of-study qualified forms listed in H 2110 sec. 2 and the multi-level forms in sec. 3, 9, 10, 11
general_notes: The level-qualified subdivisions are listed in H 2110 sec. 2 under: "The following free-floating subdivisions may be used, if appropriate:"
May Subd Geog for the level-qualified forms is inferred from the base subdivision --Study and teaching (May Subd Geog); the sheet does not mark each qualified form individually.

entries.use_under: names of individual persons, corporate bodies, and places, and under classes of persons, ethnic groups, and topical headings for works on study and teaching about these subjects
entries.notes: Do not use this subdivision under music headings, or under names of individual Christian denominations.
